dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are loads of cool things to do in Inazuma. Try the local cuisine, visit a shrine... What do you wanna do, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, food and drink. Paimon just meant we could take you to a local restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it! Alright, snack time it is! Let's go.
